segments.title: 第20章 升學宴
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 20: School Entrance Banquet

Inside Yang's Home-Style Banquet Restaurant, Zhang Xuefen, her face beaming with smiles, shuttled between private rooms three, four, and five.

Together with her son Wei Chun, she toasted the relatives and friends who had come to attend the school entrance banquet, then cheerfully accepted their red envelopes.

"Your Wei Chun is really promising, unlike our kid, whose grades are a complete mess."

"Not at all, not at all, he still has room for improvement." Zhang Xuefen said, covering her mouth with a laugh. "He only scored 525 this time, ranking 286th in the district."

"And that's not impressive? There must be several thousand students taking the high school entrance exam every year, right?" The relative laughed. "If you think that's low, you might as well let Chunchun be my son."

"Hahaha~" Zhang Xuefen was blooming with joy from the laughter, then added, "But he did get into First Affiliated High, after all."

"You all know this, but each grade at First Affiliated High has over six hundred students. After our Chunchun gets in, he'll just be at a mid-tier level."

"That just means there's a lot of room for improvement. Once he's in high school, he'll have to work even harder, right?"

Wei Chun was quite tall, but next to his mother, he kept his back hunched, making him appear a few centimeters shorter. He remained helplessly silent.

He would only utter a sound or two when Zhang Xuefen called him over to greet someone or make a toast.

Meanwhile, Wei Dongrong was also holding a wine glass, drinking and chatting with a large table of relatives, talking business about his real estate project.

A few of the relatives had already invested money and were inviting several others who were still hesitating to join in.

The conversation at the table was lively. Having had a bit too much to drink, Wei Dongrong got up to use the restroom.

As he passed by private rooms eight to ten, he suddenly caught a glimpse of some familiar figures inside.

Stopping to take a closer look, Wei Dongrong raised his eyebrows, realizing it was Li Guohong's family.

He watched as Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong, with their son Li Luo in tow, made their way between the tables to toast people, their faces full of smiles. It looked like Li Guohong's family was hosting.

It wasn't a holiday or festival, so they were probably also holding a school entrance banquet for their child, right?

With this thought, Wei Dongrong glanced at Li Luo. Hadn't his wife said before that Li Luo's grades weren't very good?

He probably had an exceptional performance on the high school entrance exam and did pretty well, right?

Thinking this, Wei Dongrong first went to the restroom, then returned to his private room and waved Zhang Xuefen over.

"What's wrong, honey?" Zhang Xuefen was happily chatting with relatives over there, basking in the pleasure of being praised and flattered. She was puzzled when Wei Dongrong called her over.

"I saw Li Guohong and his family next door." Wei Dongrong whispered in his wife's ear. "I showed them the project before, and they seemed very interested, but then I never heard back from them."

"Since we ran into them, you, me, and Chunchun should go over in a bit. We'll say we're there to congratulate their son on his school admission and, while we're at it, ask about the investment."

"If we can reach an agreement, we can ask their relatives there and see if we can attract a few more people."

"Xiuhong and the others are here too?" Zhang Xuefen was taken aback for a moment, then said with a smile, "Okay, I'll go get Chunchun, and we'll head over together."

"Be careful." Wei Dongrong reminded her. "I know you don't get along with that cousin of yours, but don't say anything out of line when we go over there."

"I know." Zhang Xuefen nodded quickly. "Don't I understand the priorities? Don't worry."

...

The private rooms at Yang's Home-Style Banquet were connected in a line.

When a large party needing several tables ate together, the partition walls in the middle could be opened to create a larger private room.

Li Luo's school entrance banquet was being held in private rooms eight to ten of Yang's Home-Style Banquet.

At a little past five in the evening, the relatives gradually arrived and took their seats.

They spent a lively half-hour eating, after which Li Luo obediently got up with his parents to make toasts.

Of course, being a minor, he could only drink juice.

And the red envelopes he received from the relatives would ultimately have to be handed over to his parents.

But seeing his grandparents on both sides healthy and happy, Li Luo was content.

He vaguely remembered that his paternal grandmother had passed away during his freshman year of university.

His maternal grandfather had died just after he graduated.

By the time he was thirty, his maternal grandmother couldn't hold on any longer.

At thirty-five, Li Luo was left with only his parents.

Worse, his mother had contracted a serious illness around that time, and her health was in a precarious state.

In comparison, Li Luo felt that being able to be reborn back to the present was an incredibly wonderful thing.

So, the words from his mouth became a bit sweeter, making the elders roar with laughter.

Coupled with Li Luo's excellent results on the high school entrance exam and his admission to First Affiliated High, which was very promising, the atmosphere in the room was excellent.

After a round of toasts, everyone continued drinking and chatting.

Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong sat down at Third Grand-uncle's table and began discussing the details of buying the house.

Because they had already confirmed things before, the conversation this time was pleasant. As for the price, especially since Third Grand-uncle's family was in a hurry to sell, and the property prices in the northern part of Yinjiang District weren't high to begin with, Li Luo's family was able to get a very favorable price.

A down payment of 500,000 yuan, plus a loan of a little over one million yuan, for a house of about one hundred and fifty square meters—that was about settled.

"But there's one thing I mentioned to you last time," Third Grand-uncle reminded them. "For this house of ours, I had it made into four bedrooms."

"Three of the student tenants just finished their college entrance exams this year and graduated, so they won't be renewing their leases."

"But there's still a young lady, who should be starting her second year of high school soon. She signed a three-year contract before."

"So if you decide to buy, you should think about whether you want to continue renting to her or not."

"In any case, the rental agreement and security deposit will be handed over to you directly. You can decide how to handle it."

Li Guohong nodded, recalling the matter, and then turned to Lin Xiuhong. "What do you think? If Li Luo and Xixi are living there, would it be better not to have an outsider disturb them?"

"But if we terminate the lease, we'd have to pay a penalty, right?" Lin Xiuhong thought for a moment and said, "Besides, she's also a student at First Affiliated High. Living together, they can help each other improve. We just need to find out what the young lady's personality is like and if they'll get along."

Hearing this, the nearby Li Luo felt a bit conflicted.

After all, if possible, he certainly wouldn't want to share a flat with a stranger.

But with his family taking on a one-million-yuan mortgage, the pressure was considerable.

If they could have a monthly rental income, it would at least alleviate some of his parents' mortgage pressure.

Although Li Luo was confident in the novel he was writing, the paid web novel market in 2014 was not very large.

Especially the paid reading market on Qidian Chinese's main site, which was nothing compared to ten years later.

Achieving an average of 3,000 subscribers for a full novel was already considered the level of a top-tier author.

On the site's bestseller list, from the tenth spot onwards, books already failed to reach 10,000 average subscriptions.

It was a far cry from the future scene where hundreds of books with over 10,000 subscriptions were being serialized simultaneously.

If the data from distribution channels was good enough, an author could even compete for the title of "Great God" on the website with just 3,000 subscriptions.

But even for such a top author, the monthly royalties from the main site were only around ten thousand yuan.

With this in mind, if possible, it was natural to earn an extra stream of income for the family.

Although his parents had made up their minds to buy the house without expecting any help from Li Luo.

But having been reborn, how could Li Luo simply enjoy his high school life with a clear conscience, without shouldering any of the family's pressure?

He should at least set a small goal first: help the family pay off this one-million-yuan mortgage sooner.

So, Li Luo said, "Since she has already signed a three-year rental contract, there's no need to terminate it, right? We can just live together."

"We have to go to school on weekdays anyway. The house is just a place to shower and sleep, so it won't be a bother."

"And on weekends, we can even motivate each other to study, can't we?"

Hearing her son say this, Lin Xiuhong nodded. "You have a point. Since you don't mind, then we certainly won't terminate the lease."

"Alright then." Seeing they had reached a decision, Third Grand-uncle said, "Let's set a time to go through all the necessary procedures for this. The sooner the transfer is done, the sooner we can all be at ease."

After finalizing the plan, everyone smiled happily.

Li Guohong raised his glass and, along with his family, toasted Third Grand-uncle again.

Just then, there was a knock on the door of the private room.

Li Luo looked toward the door and saw the figure of his cousin-uncle, Wei Dongrong, followed by his cousin-aunt, Zhang Xuefen, and his cousin, Wei Chun.

"Eh? Dongrong?" Li Guohong followed the sound with his eyes, raised an eyebrow, and got up to greet them. "What a coincidence. You guys are here too?"

"We are." Wei Dongrong walked in with a smile, holding a wine glass, and clinked it with Li Guohong's. "We're holding a school entrance banquet for Chunchun. You too, I suppose?"

"Yes, yes." Li Guohong laughed heartily and led the three of them to the table. "This kid Li Luo did pretty well on his exams, so we wanted to celebrate."

"Congratulations, congratulations." Perhaps thinking that no matter how well he did, the score wouldn't be that high, Wei Dongrong only offered a couple of verbal congratulations and a toast before changing the subject, slowly guiding it towards the real estate project.

Seeing that the two men were already talking, Zhang Xuefen, on the side, pulled Wei Chun along and walked toward Lin Xiuhong and Li Luo.

"Xiuhong, congratulations." Zhang Xuefen toasted Lin Xiuhong with a smile. "I heard your Li Luo did well on the exam this time. That's wonderful."

"Thanks." Since she was being toasted with congratulations, Lin Xiuhong didn't show any displeasure and returned the toast with a smile. "Your Wei Chun must have done well too, right? Looking at you, getting into First Affiliated High was surely no problem."

"Yes, yes, he scored 525, ranked 286th in the district. Getting into First Affiliated High is indeed no problem." Zhang Xuefen giggled, covering her mouth. Flattered by Lin Xiuhong's compliment, her mood instantly lifted. She pulled Wei Chun over and said, "Chunchun, come, toast your cousin-aunt."

"Hello, Cousin-aunt." Wei Chun raised his glass with a look of resignation.

Li Luo glanced at his mom and decided to be proactive, raising his glass as well.

The four of them clinked glasses, and the atmosphere on the surface was very pleasant.

Just as Zhang Xuefen was about to ask specifically what Li Luo had scored, Wei Dongrong walked over from the other side.

Li Guohong followed beside him, a slightly apologetic look on his face. "I'm really sorry. I was planning to let you know after we were done with the school entrance banquet."

"It's fine." Wei Dongrong wore a faint smile, his true feelings unreadable. "Since your family has other uses for this money, it's not like I can force you to buy, right? We can always cooperate again in the future."

"Yes, we can cooperate again when there's a chance." Li Guohong smiled, then turned to congratulate Wei Chun. "I just heard your Chunchun got into First Affiliated High. Here, your cousin-uncle toasts you."

"Th-thank you, Cousin-uncle." Wei Chun quickly raised his glass in response.

However, Zhang Xuefen, standing nearby, looked displeased. After hearing the conversation between Li Guohong and her husband, she knew the deal had fallen through.

So, after Li Guohong finished congratulating her son, she looked at Li Luo with a smile laced with sarcasm, raising her glass toward him. "Then I must congratulate your Li Luo too. He did well on the high school entrance exam this time. Is he planning to go to Shulan? Or Yingcai?"

She didn't even mention Second High, clearly not thinking Li Luo's score could be that good.

As soon as she said this, Li Luo's side was fine, but it was Wei Chun whose expression turned awkward.

The usually silent Wei Chun suddenly tugged on his mother's clothes and whispered, "Mom, stop it."

"What are you talking about?" Zhang Xuefen gave her son a surprised look, still not realizing what was wrong. "I'm just asking about his grades. What's wrong with being concerned about Li Luo?"

"But..." Wei Chun's face was full of embarrassment. He glanced at the composed Li Luo, wishing he could find a hole to crawl into.

After all, at last week's graduation ceremony, he had personally watched from the audience as Li Luo went on stage to receive an award.

But in the next second, Li Luo, opposite them, had already spoken with a look of pure innocence, "But Cousin-aunt, I scored 555 on the high school entrance exam, ranking 86th in the district. If I chose Shulan or Yingcai, wouldn't that be a bit inappropriate?"

The moment these words came out, the smile on Zhang Xuefen's face froze.
